environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; character-driven physical comedy; expressive facial animations; no text.

visual_logic.composition: A humorous underwater interaction scene. IN THE CENTER: The friendly paleontologist character 'dino_bones_paleontologist_4' is floating weightlessly, wearing a bright yellow scuba tank and a diving mask customized to fit perfectly over his signature thin-rimmed BLACK aviator lens glasses. He holds out a wicker basket overflowing with hard-shelled ammonites, offering them like treats. SURROUNDING HIM: Three stylized marine reptiles float in a circle, wearing deeply unimpressed, stubborn expressions. One turns its back entirely to stare at a school of sleek Eurypholis fish, another uses a front flipper to plug its nose, and the third pushes the basket away with a single polite but firm claw, showcasing that hard-shelled durophagous food is definitely not on their menu.
visual_logic.ground: Pale, high-albedo chalky seafloor with scattered white inoceramid shells and patches of green seagrass.
visual_logic.background: Crystal-clear shallow turquoise ocean waters shimmering with sunlit depth and soft-edged shadows.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, direct midday sunlight cutting down through the shallow water column, throwing crisp refractive patterns across the character's dive suit and the sleek hides of the reptiles.
